mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member ( member_id, member_passwd, member_nickname, member_name, member_email, member_type, member_phone1, member_phone2, member_phone3, member_address1, member_address2, birth_date, preferred_region, business_number, created_at ) VALUES ( #{memberID}, #{memberPasswd}, #{memberNickname}, #{memberName}, #{memberEmail}, #{memberType}, #{memberPhone1}, #{memberPhone2}, #{memberPhone3}, #{memberAddress1}, #{memberAddress2}, #{birthDate}, #{preferredRegion}, #{businessNumber}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member WHERE member_id = #{memberID}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member WHERE member_nickname = #{memberNickname}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member WHERE business_number = #{businessNumber}
